messages:
deploy-bot: heads-up: proposing a SOFT unpin of SDK 3.3.7 -> 3.4.1 for runtime:gpu-quantized-llama (canary only) during next change window. reasoning: new quant kernels require SDK hooks that 3.3.7 doesn't expose. please reply with approvals or rollback concerns.
deploy-bot: command: `deployctl unpin --target sdk --version 3.3.7 --mode soft --canary runtime:gpu-quantized-llama --window 2409127200-2409134400`
ana: ack — need to confirm canary traffic fraction. what percent are we routing to canary?
raj: current canary = 5% user requests, 10% internal integration tests. we can drop to 2% for the first 1h if we need faster rollback.
marta: quick note: telemetry shows a discrepancy in tokenization behavior between 3.3.7 and 3.4.1 for long prompt prefixes. we should add a targeted eval set to watch that.
jeff: +1 on targeted eval. also add an explicit regression alert for embeddings similarity drift. last time it popped up after a soft-unpin and we missed it.
ana: if we do soft mode, what's the exact behavior? does SDK 3.4.1 get used for new sessions only or do we rehydrate existing KV caches?
raj: soft = new sessions prefer latest runtime SDK; existing sessions stay pinned unless client sends `X-Runtime-Unpin:1`. no KV rehydrate.
lena: can we require an opt-in header for internal test traffic so we can exercise the new path without touching prod users? e.g. `X-Canary-Test: true`
ops-bot: note: change window scheduled by release calendar: start=2409127200, end=2409134400. On-call for window: @lena.
marta: put these extra checks in the rollout checklist:
```
- route: 2% prod, 20% internal (opt-in header)
- run eval: long-prefix-tokenization (10k prompts)
- run eval: embeddings-similarity-regression (50k pairs)
- observe costs / p50 latency 15m
- TTL for soft-pin fallback = 30m
```
ana: rollback plan? if we see tokenization or embeddings regression, automatic fallback to pin 3.3.7 or full rollback?
raj: plan: automated rule -> if eval alert fires OR p95 latency increases >20% for 15m we trigger immediate soft-fallback: set canary to 0% and flip `deployctl unpin --revert` to reassert pin. full rollback (reverting runtime images) only if errors >1% of requests for 10m.
jeff: add release-notes blurb: "Soft unpinning SDK 3.3.7 for runtime:gpu-quantized-llama in canary window; internal opt-in header available; watch tokenization and embeddings regressions."
lena: QA criteria from my side: pass long-prefix eval with no regression >0.5% and embedding sim drop < 2% absolute. otherwise block.
marta: noted. also document known incompat: streaming chunk sizes change (clients using chunk-parsing heuristics must be updated). adding to release notes.
ana: permissions: do we need a security review for the new header? it's just internal opt-in but double-checking.
raj: security reviewed, header is non-auth and only honored for internal service tokens. ops-bot: audit-log will record any X-Canary-Test usage.
deploy-bot: please add +1 from release lead and +1 from oncall by start-of-window to proceed.
lena: +1 from oncall (I will be oncall).
jeff: +1 release lead.
marta: +1 for QA if we limit prod to 2% and run the evals pre-start.
ana: +1 from infra (we'll monitor mem/oom).
deploy-bot: all approvals recorded. final checklist created at https://rdw.internal/release/2409123456 (private). initiating preflight jobs at 2409123580.
ops-bot: preflight job status: eval-run started (job-id eef3-2409). ETA ~12m.
jeff: if preflight fails, put a hold and ping #eng-oncall for manual decision.
ana: noted. I'll be watching alerts and the eval dashboard.
raj: keeping the revert command handy: `deployctl pin --target sdk --version 3.3.7 --reason "regression detected"`
deploy-bot: thread closed for now, will post results when preflight completes. :robot_face:
